story.text: Tradeweb's IPO closed April 8, 2019 at $27 a share, raising about $1.1 billion. The stock based on May 3 and broke out May 10, a day after its first public quarterly report: revenue of a record $186.8 million, up 10.2%, adjusted EBITDA up 10.5% to $80.3 million, and record average daily volume of $646.6 billion. Growth was steady rather than explosive, and the run peaked April 1, 2021.

story.text: Phreesia priced its IPO at $18 and began trading on July 18, 2019. It based until September 9, 2019, the day of its first report as a public company: fiscal second-quarter revenue rose 24.4% to $30.8 million, and cash rose to $100.1 million after the offering. The stock made a new high on October 31, 2019 and peaked in February 2021. I found no coverage of the share reaction.
